title: Croatian Flatbread Pizza
description: A twist on traditional pizza, using flatbread as the base and topped with cheeses and energizing ingredients. Perfect for a quick dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: Energizing
ingredients.notes: Add as much or as little as desired for a energy boost

instructions: Place flatbread on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Top with shredded cheese and chopped parsley.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
